headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, with Junior Caminero leading the offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs. Ian Seymour earned the win for the Rays, pitching 6.2 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain. Other notable injuries include Phil Maton (right knee tendinitis), Marcelo Mayer (bone stress reaction to the left ulna), Robert Suarez (right forearm tightness), Wenceel Pérez (left orbital fracture), Tony Santillan (left oblique strain), Ryne Nelson (strained right elbow), and Johan Rojas (right elbow UCL repair).

There were several trades and roster moves, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for Cole Mathis. The St. Louis Cardinals traded Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash and Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros also traded Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, with Junior Caminero leading the offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs. Ian Seymour earned the win for the Rays, pitching 6.2 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Geoff Hartlieb earning the win. Landen Roupp led the Athletics' pitching staff with 6.0 innings pitched, 6 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1, with Tatsuya Imai pitching 6.0 innings of scoreless ball, striking out 10 batters. Taylor Trammell led the Astros' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Astros Suffer Shutout Loss in Detroit**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros fell 8-0 to the Detroit Tigers in a one-sided matchup. Impact players for the Tigers included Kerry Carpenter, who contributed to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Giants Place C Daniel Susac on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Lefty Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded to the team.
